## What lives here
Build guidance and reference knowledge: items, their sources (ingest, distil, embed), retrieval with conditions and ranking, and feedback from build outcomes.

## Conventions
Distilled items arrive as "proposed" and reach builds only once approved.

## Entry points
`store.py`, `ingest.py`, `retrieval.py` and `routes/knowledge.py`.
